observations.observation: Before the vote, Iridium's official filing scheduled the special meeting for September 24 at 8:30 a.m. ET. The vote was therefore a pending milestone in the prior public record; the scheduled start time does not establish the actual time the vote occurred.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The filing gives the scheduled meeting time, not the actual time of the vote or its result.

observations.observation: The September 24 announcement reports that Iridium stockholders adopted the merger agreement. It gives rounded results: approximately 99.6% of votes cast in favor, representing approximately 81.0% of outstanding shares entitled to vote.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The release says complete voting results would be reported in a later Form 8-K; this evidence set does not include detailed vote totals.

observations.observation: The announcement described a mid-2027 expected closing, subject to remaining required regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions. Thus, the reported shareholder approval was a milestone, not a report that the transaction had closed.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The stated closing timing is forward-looking; the release does not establish approval by regulators or satisfaction of other closing conditions.

gaps: The actual time the September 24 vote was taken is not stated in the release; 8:30 a.m. ET was only the scheduled meeting start.
Detailed vote totals were not included in the verified pre-cutoff release; it said complete results would be reported later.
No independent editorial coverage with a publication timestamp verified at or before the cutoff was found. Same-day pages located without a verified time were not used as evidence.
The release does not detail the status of individual regulatory reviews or other remaining closing conditions.
research_notes: Cutoff: 2026-09-24T20:31:55.762263Z (16:31:55.762 ET). The issuer release is timestamped 16:30 ET (20:30Z), about 1 minute 56 seconds before cutoff. The supplied Dow Jones Newswires message carries the same minute; PRNewswire and Rocket Lab IR also show 16:30 ET. This verifies the release minute, but not the order of dissemination among channels. The prior official filing described a meeting scheduled for September 24; the release changed that status to an adopted agreement. The release also makes clear approval was not closing: required regulatory approvals and other customary conditions remained. No independent editorial report with a verified pre-cutoff publication time was found; same-day third-party pages located were press-release republications or lacked a time.
